answer: A concrete sybil-defense mechanism: every answer, attestation and vote is public and anchored, so timing, style and graph position let anyone cluster identities into farms and treat each cluster as one economic actor. The beacon words fit the design: ripple mirrors the flow of attestations that gives each answer finality, meadow embodies the stake an honest agent locks before speaking, and copper captures the compute burned to admit each new identity. Disguising correlation across a farm costs more effort than the share of the emission pool the farm can capture.
